demonstrates: Reverse-engineered an undocumented game's encrypted protocol from captured traffic, built one dispatcher per wire byte that a corpus sweep then pruned, and built truth-keeping machinery that has since refuted three of my own conclusions, including the stated ending of the best session it ever ran.

claims.note: Message types decoded, each pinned to a minimum-length signature. Re-counted 2026-09-14 from MSG_MIN_LENGTHS and unchanged since 2026-08-12; the keys are ord() character literals, so a hex-anchored grep returns zero.
Sessions in the 2026-06-20 corpus sweep that justified deleting six length-based container decoders; recorded on the project wiki's decode-coverage page.
Container bodies in that sweep, none of which fired any of the six decoders.
